text:
maya: Quick heads up — coordinating a sync with Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant teams for the ingest adapter launch next week. Need to confirm marketplace intake timeline, HW cert preflight, and integration checklist ownership. Who can take the checklist?

alex: I can own the integration checklist and the release steps. Will need eng-infra to provide the HW test matrix and eng-runtime to confirm perf targets. @lina can you own the deploy docs?

lina: Yep — I will add private/VPC install steps, KMS/HSM notes, and a perf test harness. Also need a representative sample dataset and schema. Sam, do we have a sanitized sample we can use?

sam: We have the retail-orders sample but legal flagged PII. I can generate a synthetic dataset from devex tooling and share a link. Also can draft the PR copy if someone gives me the feature/benefit bullets.

maya: Marketplace intake submitted? marketplace-bot: 

marketplace-bot: Marketplace intake form received — https://marketplace.redwood.ai/submit/INGEST-1876 (intake id INGEST-1876). Please attach the operator docs and a 1-paragraph listing description.

alex: For HW cert (NVIDIA partner), runtime needs perf targets: 99p latency <=200ms for 512-token inference under 8 concurrent streams (target hw ≈ A6000). Also need memory/kv-cache usage numbers. Lina, can you capture those?

lina: Adding perf targets and test scripts to the checklist. Also adding fallback behavior: quantized model variant for low-memory nodes.

sam: Finance will want cost estimates for Dedicated capacity vs hosted. @maya can you route to finance for committed vs on-demand numbers?

maya: On it — will create a 1-pager for finance + product ROI. PR plan: do we want a joint blog + marketplace highlight at launch or wait until 3 pilot customers? Opinions?

alex: Joint blog + marketplace listing at launch is ideal for momentum. Webinar can be scheduled after pilots have results. Keep messaging conservative on performance until we have verified numbers.

lina: I'll draft the on-prem install runbook and include the KMS steps and network requirements. Also adding smoke test steps: health probe, example ingest, and KV cache priming.

sam: Devops asked for the deploy command for the adapter to run smoke tests — pasting below:

alex: Sure — example helm commands:
```
helm repo add redwood https://helm.redwood.ai/charts
helm upgrade --install redwood-ingest ./charts/ingest-adapter --set provider=snowflake --values values.prod.yaml
```
Smoke test script: `./scripts/smoke_ingest.sh --provider snowflake`

maya: Action items (summary):
- alex: integration checklist + release playbook + perf targets
- lina: deploy docs + perf matrix + fallback notes
- sam: synthetic dataset + PR draft + anonymized sample link
- maya: marketplace intake + finance ask + PR coordination
- legal-team: review copy + dataflow diagram + compliance notes
Target: internal signoff by EOD Thursday, external announcement next Tuesday.

legal-team: We need the final copy and a detailed dataflow diagram before Tuesday. Also confirm data handling for EU customers (DPO sign-off).

nvidia-partner: NVIDIA cert team can run the validation next Wednesday if the test matrix and scripts are delivered by Tuesday EOD.

sam: I'll anonymize and upload the sample by Tue noon and post the link here.

maya: Thanks all. I'll set a 15m sync tomorrow 9:30am PT to go over blockers. Invite sent. (reacted :thumbsup: by alex)
